All 8 required hooks exist, every acceptance test passes, and smoke at 15:00 prints OK on all 3 viewports.

**Shared hot spots touched (one new line each):**
- fresh(): `{const f36=fresh;fresh=function(){const s=f36();b36Fix(s);return s}}// B36`, right after the f39 line.
- migrate(): `try{if(typeof b36Fix==='function')b36Fix(S)}catch(e){}// B36`, right after the condoFix line.
- frame(): `if(typeof b36Frame==='function')b36Frame(dt,T);// B36`, right after `b40Frame(dt,T);`.

**State** (b36Fix(s) is a hoisted, data-only function):
- `S.you.req=[{id:'dayKey:templateIndex',k,kind,a,b,item,n,got,day}]`, holding at most 3.
- `S.you.shc={keeperId:[goodShifts,lastDayKey,total]}`.
- `S.you.rqd='dayKey|id,id'` lists today's finished favors.
- `S.you.wf` is the wishing-fountain day; `S.you.yev` lists events you attended; `S.you.fav` counts favors.
- `S.found=[{k:'umb'|'treat'|'check',by,t}]`, at most 4.

**Deviations from the spec:**
- `S.you.day.sh` is already B25's stamp list, so shifts use `S.you.shc`.
- `S.you.wish` is B25's wishlist, so the fountain uses `S.you.wf`.
- There is no `S.you.notes`. Notes go into the existing cabin mailbox (`S.visYou.mb`, cap 8, and `S.you.home.mb`) through `b36Note(t,txt)`.
- The board canvas is 512x384 to match the B8 board face, not 512x640.

**Friendships:**
- `youTier(idOrPts)` uses thresholds `YT=[0,15,45,100,180]` and names `YTN` (stranger, acquaintance, friend, good friend, close friend).
- `youRelAdd(id,n,why)` adds hearts; `relUnlock(id,r)` sets rel[6] bits once each: 8 acquaintance, 16 friend gift (from FGIFT, found in the catalog via `b36Cat`, put in your storage, plus a mailbox note), 32 good friend invitation note, 64 close friend photo note.
- These existing functions are wrapped by reassignment:
  - `relOf`: the first chat of the day now gives +3 in total, and every touch runs the unlock check.
  - `priceOf`: 5% off at a friend's shop.
  - `npcReply`: the 'hi' line can open with your visit rhythm, a nickname (NICK) or a shift title (SHTITLE). The 'about' backstory now unlocks by your tier (layer 1 at friend, 2 at good friend, 3 at close friend); below friend you get a generic intro.

**Shifts:**
- `shiftOk(k)`, `shiftDo(k,tier)` (pays SHPAY 8/14/20, +3 hearts, stampShop, news with Jesse's name) and `shiftStart(k)` (async; runs the intro, the game and the result card).
- MiniGame shell `MG`: a #mg canvas overlay (z-index 70, DPR-aware, 30 fps cap, stops when hidden, sets `SHEETS.set('mg','full')`).
  - `mgIntro(keeper,line)` returns Promise<bool>; `mgRun(game,secs)` returns Promise<tier 0..3>; `mgCard`, `mgEnd(quit)`, `mgOpen(on)`.
  - Games: mgLatte, mgShelf, mgStack and mgWrap (table MGAMES, keeper mapping SHG). A shift lasts 50 s.
- Talk card: wrapped `npcChips` puts "Need a hand today?" (open shop, not worked today) and "Can I help? ❗" first; the topic chip, then "How's Mocha?", give way.

**Favors:**
- 15 templates in `REQT`: deliver ×3, relay ×2, lost ×2, fetch ×2, gosee, flyers, water, umb, treat, check. Positions in `RQSPOT`.
- `rqOffers(dayKey)` is seeded by date: 2–3 a day, 3–4 on weekends, one per giver. Offers expire at `rqBed(k)` and held favors expire at the giver's bedtime, with no penalty.
- Also `rqAccept`, `rqFinish(i,{force})` (coins 5–25, +10 hearts to the giver, +3 to the recipient of a delivery, news, sometimes a note or an item), `rqText` and `rqCarry`.
- `npcRequest(id,peek)` is the B23 seam: peek drives the "!"; otherwise it completes what you brought them or accepts today's favor. Wrapped `talkOpen` auto-completes a delivery or relay when you talk to the recipient, and a lost/go-see/fetch favor when you talk to the giver.
- `rqScan(dt)` runs at 4 Hz: picking up the lost item at its glint, the Needle, flyers, standing 3 s in Wendell's garden, porch drops (write `S.found`), and checking on Mocha within 4.
- `b36Found()` writes his diary line when he is next doing something at home. Nothing writes G.
- The carried item is a box, bag or envelope mesh in group `b36carry` on `visitor`; the lost item shows as a mesh named `b36glint`.

**Events:**
- `TOWN_EVENTS` (with `TEVB`), `tevOn(t)`, `tevNow(t)`.
- `B36ACT` event acts (fx 'tev', with `ok(t)`) plus `B36BRD` (he reads the board; fx 'board') and `B36WSH` (his wish on holidays and his birthday; fx 'wishm') are pushed into ACTS and I5.acts, so INT5A's wrapper gates them by time.
- `tevAct` sets `hw` to 2..3 by interest, +.4 if he read the board that day. Outcomes are in `LOFX.tev`, `LOFX.board` and `LOFX.wishm` (data only; trivia is answered right when the topic is in S.learned).
- The calendar's selected day box shows the day's event through a wrapped `renderCal` (`TABS.R.cal` is updated).

**Board:**
- `boardData(t)` and `boardDraw36()` swap the B8 `SQUARE.board.tex` image to a 512x384 canvas. `nbSig36()` checks for changes every 5 s.
- Wrapped `boardChips` adds Events this week, Requests and Toss a wish coin.
- `b36Wish()` costs one coin a day; `b36Lucky()` plus a `natGather` wrapper give +3 coins on the next day's first find.

**Square:** `SQ` and `sqBuild()` add 40 spray Points (b36spray, glowTex map), an ice disc (b36ice), 6 pigeons in one CHIBI_MAT InstancedMesh (b36pigeons; they scatter within 2.5 and come back after 6 s), and dressing meshes `B36.dress[trivia|market|openmic|artwalk]` (one Batcher-merged BAKEMI mesh each, shown only in the window). `sqFrame` runs per frame; spray and pigeons are off under `SET.saver||TIER.n===0`, inside interiors, or with the camera target farther than 50/60. All of it is built at boot so LF1 inWorldBuild picks it up.

**Town tab:** `TABS.sub('town','people'|'week'|'tnews')` with `renderPeople` (38 cards, live npcStatus refreshed every 2 s by `peopleLive`), `renderWeek` and `renderTNews`. `peopleList()` gives the data. Still 6 top-level tabs.

**1 Hz tick:** `b36Hz()` handles favor expiry, the carried item, the frozen check, the board signature, dressing visibility, event toasts within 60, attendance within 10 (+4 hearts to the host, once a day), `S.found`, and the people refresh.

  - `biz={pid:[cash,trend7,mood,strat,upgBits,openDays,until,real,extra,nStrat]}`. trend7 packs 7 days as 4-bit values (8 = normal). mood is -2..2. strat is one of '', sale, spec, ev, fav, grant, brk, reno, hire, spons; `until` is its last day key. upgBits are renovations (4 bits). `real` is today's real sales and `extra` today's wages and catches paid.

**Economy**
- `EB37` sets each of the 19 shops' base, rain and sun multipliers, season curve (`ESEA`) and keeper skill.
- `econSim` and `econRev(pid,dk,'rain'|'sun')` are pure and seeded per date and shop. Revenue = base × season × WX × weekday (`EDOW`) × holiday × tourism × events (`EEV`) × word of mouth × skill × strategy × noise.
- `econDay(dk)` adds the real sales, then subtracts stock, 5% rent, 3% tax, wages and utilities. It updates cash, the trend and the mood (normalized by season^.75), calls `econStrat`, settles town funds, writes 1–2 Gazette headlines to `S.econ.log` and `newsPush('econ',…,mocha=false)`, and redraws signs that changed. It averages about 0.2 ms a day (under 2 ms tested).
- `econCatch(now)` runs from the 1 Hz tick: the first tick after 6:00 settles yesterday plus any missed days (at most 30). A new town warms up 7 quiet days first. It then calls `careerNight`.
- Strategies (`econStrat`):
  - Struggling shops cycle sale → special → event → favor → grant, and rarely `brk`: closed for 1–2 days through the wrapped `tShut`, then back with a new idea.
  - Thriving shops renovate (an upgBit), post a hiring opening (at most 2 at a time) or sponsor a festival.
- Sale prices: the wrapped `priceOf` takes 20% off.
- Signs: the wrapped `chalkDraw` repaints the existing B9 chalkboard A-frame cell through `b37Chalk`, with a coloured tag (SALE, SPECIAL, TONIGHT, BACK SOON, NEW LOOK, HELP WANTED, PROUD SPONSOR) and an original line from `ESALE`/`ESPEC`.

- `careerNight` runs inside the morning settle. It handles the announcement, a missed hunt or interview, satisfaction drift and kind quitting (low satisfaction for 14 days, a finished dream with no wants left, or a better opening).
- `careerAnnounce` writes "I think I want a job. Not because I have to. Because I want a piano…".
- `careerHunt` picks the best `jobFit` (interest, keeper bond, hours vs sleep, pay, +.1 if the shop is posting an opening). It books an interview and sets `S.heart.wy={k:'job',…}`. If nothing fits it turns to freelance (art stall, busking, Gazette column) or waits a week.
- `careerHire` writes the hire (3 work days, a window chosen around his sleep) plus news.
- `careerQuit` gives notice; the keeper bond goes up by 2.
- `jobWin`, `careerDays` and `careerLine` produce the Me-tab and Town-tab text.
- Acts (pushed into ACTS and I5.acts, gated through `ok(t)`):

- `LOFX.shift` pays once per day (pay + seeded tips). It debits the shop through `econCost`, raises sat by .05·e, adds `bondAdd(keeper,3)`, writes a `SHIFT_LINES[role]` diary line and gives sparks. The first day becomes a core memory plus `S.firsts.job`. Raises come after every 8 good shifts; rank 2 is "head …" and fires `dreamCheck('event','promo')`. Step 2: 'community garden' (also needs an O lot, and L9 is the only one) is approved 5-0 with why='waiting for a lot that fits', and the fund still drops 1625→1225. Step 3: after b38.catchUp over +20 days it is still ['Corner Green Garden','approved',null,'waiting for a lot that fits']. Filing it again returns ok:false 'dup' with the line "There is already a petition for Corner Green Garden. Ask folks to sign it!", but nobody can sign it. Cause: b38Fund takes the money before it calls b38LotFor, and nothing ever re-checks petitions in 'approved'. Lots: only L1 is S, only L2 is L, only L9 is O, only L6 is P, and there are 7 lots for 22 templates. So boba, the three L-class businesses, the three O-class businesses and the two P-class businesses each fight over one lot, and once every lot is used, every later approval loses its money.
findings.repro: __mocha.petition('dog park','you'); sign 6 people with force; __mocha.council(). Then __mocha.petition('community garden','you'); sign 6 with force; __mocha.council(). Compare S.town.fund before and after, then run __mocha.b38.catchUp(now+20d) and read petitions().
findings.suggested_fix: Check b38LotFor(tpl) before voting or funding. With no free lot: deny with the reason 'no lot that fits', or hold the petition as pending without charging. In b38Catch, retry 'approved' petitions when a lot frees up and only charge at that point. b38Score could also count lot availability as a 'town needs' reason. Leave 'approved' out of b38New's dup check, or say that it is waiting for a lot.

findings.title: Opening the game on Wednesday between 18:00 and 20:00 settles that night's votes silently at boot, so there is no live council, no bubbles and Mocha cannot attend
findings.location: index.html b38Boot (l.13953) → b38Catch (l.13830): `now>=p.voteAt+(B38.live?2*36e5:0)` runs while B38.live is still 0
findings.evidence: Probe p4.js. On Tue Nov 3 15:00 I filed 'music venue' (voteAt Wed Nov 4 18:00) and signed 3 names, then set the clock to Wed 18:05 and reloaded. Right after boot the result was already in: pet=[['The Lantern Room','building','L8','',{y:3,n:2,...}]], S.town.cn=20261104, B38.bub=[]. Running the 18:20 tick (b38.tick) gave bub:0, because b38Tick needs cn!==today and a petition in 'sigs'. B38ACT.hw also drops to -30 once no petition is in 'sigs', so Mocha's 'watch the council vote' act is gone. The members still sit on the dais until 19:30 with nothing to vote on.
findings.repro: File a petition on Tuesday, then reload the page on Wednesday at any time from 18:00 to 19:59. petitions() shows it already decided and B38.bub is empty.
findings.suggested_fix: At boot, give 'sigs' petitions the same grace as live play: set B38.live=1 before the first b38Catch, or skip voteAt within the last 2 h when the current time is inside the 18:00–19:30 window. b38Tick then runs the council in front of the player.

findings.title: Mocha only ever petitions for a music venue: his council petitions have exactly one source

findings.title: Mocha's Town Fund donation is also recorded as a sale at a shop (B37 coin tracker)

findings.title: The maker's 'lot' build zone calls b38LotFor with the wrong arguments, so it always returns null

findings.title: Owner shift and favor news fills the 16-slot town news and pushes out every Mocha and Gazette item; Town > news then shows 'quiet so far'
findings.location: index.html:14226 (shiftDo newsPush 'you'), 14189 (rqFinish newsPush 'you'), 14356 (event attendance newsPush), 778 (newsPush keeps only the last 16 entries for all kinds)
findings.evidence: Every shift and every favor calls newsPush('you',...), and S.town.news is capped at 16 entries shared by all kinds. Probe p9: after a 3-day catch-up the town news held 9 items (3 'Mocha found ...', 2 econ Gazette lines, a pet, a painting, a goal). After 19 shifts and today's 2 favors it held 16 items, all of kind 'you' ('Jesse worked a shift at ...'), and 0 others. Town > news then shows 'town news: quiet so far' with 'overheard' full of shift lines (screenshot /tmp/harness/rv-5b/econ/town-news-after-shifts-portrait.png). Keep a single daily 'you' line updated in place (for example 'Jesse helped out at 5 shops today'), or move 'you' news into its own small capped list. Or give newsPush a per-kind quota so 'you' entries can never take more than about 4 of the 16 slots.

findings.title: On a cold start, Mocha's offline time is simulated before B37 loads: he takes odd jobs at his own workplace and at other shops during shift hours, then b37Away also pays those shifts
findings.location: index.html:5972 (the boot catchUp runs before the B37 block), 14572 (odd-job gate at his workplace), 14574 (shift short-cut in localChoose), 14605 (b37Away pays missed shifts afterwards)
findings.evidence: At boot, catchUp() runs before B37SH is in ACTS, before the round-1 odd-job gate is installed, and before the payJob/localChoose wrappers exist. On the first 1 Hz tick, b37Away then adds a paid shift for each missed shift day without checking what catchUp already wrote. Probe p6 (job at the café, 9-17, away 3 days, reload): the diary shows 'Sun Nov 01 08:14 Helped Juniper behind the counter during the rush' (a paid round-1 odd job at his own workplace, which the spec says a real job replaces), then 'Sun 09:30 My first day as a barista'. It also shows 'Mon 09:30 shift paid' alongside 'Mon 12:06 Helped Kip wash a muddy mountain bike' and 'Tue 11:59 Helped Hank unload apples' in the middle of his café shift. He is paid twice for the same hours, and the odd-job pay is not taken from any shop's ledger.
findings.repro: cd /tmp/harness/rv-5b/econ && node run.js p6.js 3 15 desktop. The script hires Mocha at the café, backdates lastSeen and career.lt by 3 days, blocks saves and reloads. Read the 'AFTER RELOAD' work diary.
findings.suggested_fix: Make the job data-only and visible to the boot catchUp: hoist B37SH and the odd-job gate (or a shiftNow check inside scoreAct) above catchUp, so the boot catchUp both blocks the odd job at his workplace and picks the shift. Or have b37Away first remove or skip catchUp acts that fall inside the shift window, and skip paying a shift on a day when catchUp already logged a job there.

findings.title: Balance: every one of the 19 keepers offers a daily shift, so shifts dwarf every other income. 7-day ledger: owner 120 -> 2324, Mocha 150 -> 36..145
findings.location: index.html:14221 (SHG maps all 19 keepers to a game), 14223 (shiftOk: one per keeper per day, no daily total), 14222 (SHPAY 8/14/20)
findings.evidence: Simulated 7 days (Nov 3-9; p3 with a mutable clock, logs in /tmp/harness/rv-5b/econ/sim-nojob.txt and sim-job.txt). OWNER, active once a day: shifts at tier 2 +1862 (19 x 14 x 7), favors +204 (21-42 a day), Neighbor Dividend +145 (about 21 a day), wish -7, so 120 -> 2324. Gathering, fishing and selling are not included; they pay 1-25 per action. At tier 3 the shifts alone are 380 a day for about 19 one-minute games. They also fill all 19 stamp cards in 8 days. MOCHA, living on his own: 150 -> 145 (about 8 odd jobs at 12-18; bought a 120-coin phone). He decided on day 4 to look for a job and was hired as a barista Tue/Thu/Sat 1-5pm at 27 a shift. MOCHA hired from day 0: 150 -> 36 (4 shifts at about 30 including 3-5 tips, plus 3 odd jobs). So his 4-hour shift earns about what two owner mini-game minutes earn, and later acts in the same shift pay nothing ({more:1}). TOWN funds 2042 -> 2925 (about +126 a day, with nothing to spend it on unless B38 builds).
findings.repro: cd /tmp/harness/rv-5b/econ && node run2.js p3.js 3 15 desktop. Use JOB=1 to hire him first. Each day the script runs every shift at tier 2, every favor, the gazette and a wish, jumps 24 h, and runs catchUpDays(1).
findings.suggested_fix: Limit paid shifts to a small daily budget: for example 3 keepers seeded per day offer shifts, or the first 2-3 shifts a day pay 8/14/20 and later ones give hearts and stamps only. Retune so an active owner day comes to roughly 60-100 coins, in line with favors, gathering and Mocha's 20-30 a day.

findings.title: Donations to the Town Fund jar are also counted as shop revenue (Mocha's always, the owner's when made inside a shop)
findings.location: index.html:14489-14492 (addCoins wrapper: 'b38:fund' is not in the exclusion list), 14496 (b37Coins treats any drop in S.coins as a sale), 13941 (b38Donate)
findings.evidence: Probe p5: with a pending petition, b38.donate(10,'mocha') moved 10 coins into the jar, and on the next tick b37Coins booked +10 as grocery 'real' sales (realDelta {grocery:10}). Probe p2: the owner donated 10 from Town > shops while lfForce.in(1,'cafe') was active, and café real sales went 0 -> 10. findings.title: Struggling shops still make money every day; in the 7-day replay the only shop that lost money was a mood +2 shop
findings.location: index.html:14468-14474 (econDay: costs are about 74% of base, and mood is measured against the seasonal expectation)
findings.evidence: Probe p11 (boot Nov 10, econTick(7)): the 4 shops at mood -1 (market, bikes, station, nursery, with SALE or SPECIAL signs and 'slow week' lines) still gained +207, +40, +135 and +72 cash. Every other shop gained 135-693. The only loss was Lantern & Wick, at mood +2, which spent 72 sponsoring a festival. A shop's ledger only falls when it chooses to spend, never because business is bad, so 'make and lose money believably' does not happen.
findings.repro: cd /tmp/harness/rv-5b/econ && node run.js p11.js 10 15 desktop
